findings.finding: An earlier build printed the route contract's requiredFacts array on the face of the petition as this route's fact set - fourteen items running 'Exact route?', 'Arrest/charge limitations?', 'Prosecutor declination?', 'Reversal/dismissal?', 'DNA innocence?', 'Pardon?', 'Deferred order and dismissal?', 'Full-record versus court-record relief?', 'Reclassification date?', 'Fine amount/payment?', 'Trafficking nexus?', 'Juvenile completion?', 'VPO hearing/vacatur/death?' and 'Portal/automatic status?'. All eleven Oklahoma routes carry that identical array under ruleId OK-SB2030-2026-ELEVEN-ROUTE-TRANSITION-MAP, so it is an analyst checklist for choosing among sibling routes rather than this section 19c petition's fact set.
findings.consequence: The petition no longer reads that shared array. Section C now identifies the existing court, county and case number, the prostitution-related offense and disposition, the relief counsel advises under section 19c, and the trafficking-nexus evidence counsel selects without asking for a survivor narrative. The fourteen strings are removed from this builder's route-contract anchors because the family no longer consumes them.

findings.finding: Correcting the route contract's requiredFacts array itself is not part of this one-family repair. That array is shared by eleven Oklahoma routes under one ruleId.
findings.consequence: The shared record remains unchanged. This packet stops reading it as participant filing facts; changing the source array requires separately assigned authority over every affected route.

findings.finding: The compiled Oklahoma pathway records that this route 'should be routed to legal aid or an attorney because the petition needs sensitive facts and supporting proof.'
findings.consequence: That is the committed record's own SELF_HELP_STOP answer, quoted first on the packet and first in the stop conditions, and no page asks the participant to write those sensitive facts out.

findings.finding: The compiled profile records that relief can be by court MOTION or PETITION, without naming which the court takes.
findings.consequence: The packet composes a petition, states that a motion is the recorded alternative, and names the court clerk's office as the authority on which the court accepts. It does not choose for the participant a form of process the record leaves open.

findings: boundary.pdf carried a fifth page whose only ink was the route footer, drawn at the top of the page: a blank separator sitting in the last slot of page 2 spent that slot and pushed the document's final line onto a page of its own. The renderer now simulates its own layout and collapses the blank separators in front of any line that would otherwise sit alone on a page, leaving every other page break where it was. Boundary is 4 pages and matches canonical; canonical is byte-identical, because nothing on it was stranded.
boundary.pdf moved in that repair, so the family's RASTER_PASS receipt no longer covers the family and a fresh whole-family raster is required before any further read.
